cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); Selma Schubart, New York, NY, 1920s; Private collection, New York, NY, bequest, 1957; (Robert Miller Gallery, Inc., New York, NY); Hirschl & Adler Galleries, Inc., New York, NY, 1978; Private collection, San Francisco, California, 1978; Hirschl & Adler Galleries, Inc., New York, NY 1981 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. One of a series O'Keeffe completed at Lake George 1918/1920, see cat. nos. 270–74. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication dates this work as 1918–1920, Carnegie Museums of Pittsburgh dates it as 1919. (Source: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* from Carnegie Museums of Pittsburgh.)
